name: InterContinental Chengdu Global Center
positioning: Parent-child resort hotel inside Chengdu's Global Center, with ocean-themed rooms and semi-outdoor pools
best_for: Families who want a resort-style city stay with a children's pool
Travelers who want metro access and shopping steps away

facts.text: The hotel is located within the Global Center, which together with its shopping mall and ocean park forms a city-within-a-city.
The Global Center is the world's largest monolithic building.
The hotel has direct access to Metro Line 1.
Guests can walk to the SKP department store from the hotel.
The hotel has a semi-outdoor infinity pool.
The hotel has semi-outdoor hot spring pools.
The pool facilities include a children's pool.
Premium Rooms can be configured with a king bed and a bunk bed.
Phoenix Pavilion offers authentic Cantonese and classic Sichuan cuisine.
Paradise Island Cafe is a poolside all-day dining restaurant serving an international buffet and a la carte selections.
The hotel recommends the Tianfu Greenway in Guixi Ecological Park, one of the premier starting points for cycling.
The Panda Base is 26 kilometers from the hotel.

highlights.text: Guest rooms are ocean-themed with panoramic balconies.
The hotel sits within the Global Center, which with its shopping mall and ocean park forms a city-within-a-city.
The hotel has semi-outdoor hot spring pools.
The hotel describes itself as a parent-child resort hotel.
The hotel has direct access to Metro Line 1.

considerations.text: The hotel is 60 km from Tianfu Airport.
The parking lot is not managed by the hotel; it is complimentary for in-house guests, one car per room.
WhataHotel notes the large complex can feel overwhelming for some guests.
